item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Kremlin discusses potential trilateral peace talks, comments on US trip by Putin’s envoy
item.description: According to Dmitry Peskov, it is too early to assess the results of Kirill Dmitriev’s trip to the United States

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): First post-election Duma meeting slated for September 30 — presidential decree
item.description: The election to the 9th Russian State Duma took place on September 18-20

item.title: Meduza: After Ukraine’s overnight attack, Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery — one of southern Russia’s biggest fuel suppliers — halts operations
item.description: The Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery in the Rostov region halted operations after an attack by Ukrainian drones, Rostov Governor Yuri Slyusar said.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Russia’s Prozorova advances to semifinals of 2026 WTA Singapore Open
item.description: Tatyana Prozorova is now set to play in the semifinals round against the winner of the match between unseeded Talia Gibson from Australia and Greek 7th-seeded Maria Sakkari

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Demand for UAV technicians training exceeds need for operators — expert
item.description: "The development of technical capabilities is driven by the fact that every unit is now organizing its own UAV technical workshop," Mikhail Filippov said

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): AfD parliamentary group calls for blocking Ukraine’s EU, NATO accession
item.description: The Alternative for Germany said that extending the provision on assistance under Article 42 of the Treaty on European Union to Ukraine would risk involving Germany in a conflict with Russia

item.title: Meduza: United Russia won 349 of 450 seats in Russia’s new State Duma. Parliament will include 46 war participants.
item.description: The head of the Central Election Commission, Ella Pamfilova, announced the results of the State Duma elections, held September 18–20.

item.title: Meduza: Vladimir Putin has an eight-year-old granddaughter — Elza Tikhonova. Her parents are the Russian president’s younger daughter and ballet dancer Igor Zelensky.
item.description: Vladimir Putin has an eight-year-old granddaughter, the daughter of Katerina Tikhonova, head of the Innopraktika foundation and the Russian president’s younger daughter, and ballet dancer Igor Zelensky. Journalists with the Russian investigative outlet Proekt found that the girl is named Elza Igorevna Tikhonova.

item.title: Meduza: Finnish President Stubb asks Elon Musk to expand Starlink coverage for Ukraine so it can strike missile launchers on Russian territory
item.description: Finnish President Alexander Stubb has called on Elon Musk to expand Starlink satellite internet coverage so Ukraine can strike missile launchers on Russian territory, Reuters reported.

item.title: Meduza: 17 servicemen swept into Caspian Sea during military exercises in Kazakhstan. 14 died, most of them conscripts.
item.description: Seventeen servicemen were swept into the Caspian Sea during naval exercises in Kazakhstan’s Mangystau region. Fourteen of them died, Kazakhstan’s Defense Ministry said.

item.title: Meduza: Russian state news agency published a column threatening Lithuania with Russia’s ‘next SVO.’ Hours later, it was deleted.
item.description: The Russian state news agency RIA Novosti published a column headlined “Russia Is In for Another SVO. It Will Be Very Short,” which threatened Lithuania with a nuclear strike.

item.title: The Moscow Times: United Russia Wins Record State Duma Majority in Elections Dubbed as Most Uncompetitive in Modern History
item.description: The outcome was all but predetermined in Russia’s tightly controlled political system, where true opposition had been barred from the ballot.

item.title: Meduza: One in three members of Russia’s new State Duma has ties to the war in Ukraine. Some are accused of war crimes. Here’s who they are — and what they’ve done.
item.description: Russia has held its first State Duma elections since the start of the full-scale war. According to preliminary results, United Russia has won a record number of seats — more than three-quarters of the chamber. The party has already said that 49 “participants in the special military operation” will become lawmakers on its ticket, effectively answering Putin’s call for military personnel to become Russia’s “new elite.” But they make up only part of what might be called the Duma’s “war faction.”…

item.title: The Moscow Times: At Least 2 Killed as Ukraine Strikes Industrial Sites Across Russia
item.description: Russian authorities and independent media reported that two oil refineries were damaged during the overnight drone barrage.

item.title: Meduza: Moscow–Tolyatti passenger train damaged by ‘external interference,’ injuring driver and halting rail traffic
item.description: Passenger train No. 66 Moscow–Tolyatti sustained damage to its locomotive and first car after “outside interference” on the Racheika–Belasheika stretch in the Samara region, the Kuibyshev Railway reported.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Regions Calling: Russia’s Got a Bear Problem
item.description: At least 19 people have been killed in brown bear attacks across the country since April. What is going on?

item.title: The Moscow Times: State Duma Creates New AI Oversight Committee
item.description: Former President Dmitry Medvedev announced the creation of the Committee on Digital Development and Artificial Intelligence.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Finance Ministry Unveils 2027 Budget Draft With Fresh Tax Hikes to Fund War Deficit
item.description: The proposed tax hikes come just weeks after the Kremlin insisted that officials were not discussing any further increases.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Krasnodar Region Declares State of Emergency as Ukrainian Strikes Cripple Grain Exports
item.description: Authorities said many farmers in the region have been unable to sell their grain due to disruptions to export infrastructure.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Belarus Claims It Foiled ‘Sabotage’ Plot Targeting Russia
item.description: The KGB security service of Belarus said the alleged sabotage operation was coordinated from neighboring Ukraine.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Kremlin Weighs U.S. Invitation for Putin to Attend G20 Summit in Miami
item.description: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that Russia was “grateful for and appreciative of this invitation.”

item.title: The Moscow Times: Firms Linked to Putin Classmate Win $1.5Bln in Moscow School Meal Contracts, Report Says
item.description: The lucrative school catering business was once held by companies owned by late Wagner mercenary group founder Yevgeny Prigozhin.
